Name: New Years Eve
Author: YriKururu
Description:
[center][u][b][size=4]Celebrate New Years Eve in Stardew Valley! [/size][/b][/u]
[size=2]Originally created for the 2023 Mod Jam
[/size]
[size=3]You are formally invited to join the yearly New Year's Eve Celebration.
Welwick looked to the stars and got you a yearly review, so go on a voyage down memory lane and then enjoy the fireworks show for a new year!

[b][u]HOW TO TRIGGER THE EVENT:
[/u][/b]1. You get mail at the 21st of Winter informing you about the event.
2. Go to the Railroad on Winter 28 between 10PM and 1AM (note: the letter says 10PM to midnight. This isn't a bug - the intended time to visit is between 10PM and midnight, but if you're running a little late, you'll still be able to see it)
3. Enjoy your feedback!

[u][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/u]
If any of the following custom NPCs are installed, they will also join the event!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url]﻿﻿: Sterling, Mia & Henry
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10627]Yri the Architect[/url]: Yri & Charles
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307]Lucikiel[/url]
